### Summary

Coming from https://github.com/readthedocs/readthedocs.org/pull/13336#issuecomment-5793204051

It seems that when `--no-sync` is present, other option that affects what is synced are ignored. For the same example with `--no-dev`, the explanation for the explanation for the option documents

> Disable the development dependency group [env: UV_NO_DEV=]

but when you check

```
uv sync
uv run --no-dev <binary_from_dev_group>
```

it works just fine, contradicting the option's documentation. What does this option do is that it alters the sync behaviour but not completely disables the mentioned group.

I think all options with a similar case should have their documentation updated to prevent further confusion.
